mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_review_issue (review_id, category_id, description, create_time) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, NOW())

INSERT INTO t_review_issue (review_id, category_id, description, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.reviewId}, #{item.categoryId}, #{item.description}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_review_issue i JOIN t_issue_category c ON i.category_id = c.id GROUP BY i.category_id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_review_issue i WHERE i.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(i.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ASC

SELECT i.id, i.review_id AS reviewId, i.category_id AS categoryId, i.description, c.name AS categoryName FROM t_review_issue i LEFT JOIN t_issue_category c ON i.category_id = c.id WHERE i.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY i.category_id, i.id
SELECT id, name, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM t_issue_category ORDER BY sort_order
